gsms_0091.schema: {name}'s house holds {mult} as many {food1}s as {food2}s, and there are {n} {food2}s in it in total. At the store he bought {m} more {food2}s, and {k} fewer {food1}s than the number of {food2}s. What is the combined total of the number of {food1}s and {food2}s {name} has in the house?

gsms_0092.schema: With his mighty {weapon1}, {name1} slew {n1} {creature}. {name2} slew {frac1} as many {creature} as {name1}, using a {weapon2}, and {name3} slew {mult1} as many {creature} as {name2} with a {weapon3}. {name4}, who had forgotten his {weapon4} at home and had to make do with a {weapon5}, slew {frac2} as many {creature} as {name3}. How many {creature} has {name4} slain?

gsms_0093.schema: {name} swims a {unit} in {t1} minutes when the water is cold. In warm water he needs {n} minutes more than {mult} as long. Over {d} {unit}s, how much longer does a hot day take him than a cold day?

gsms_0094.schema: A job at {company} draws {n} applicants. Interviews go to only {p1}% of those who apply, job offers to {p2}% of those who are interviewed, and of the people who receive a job offer, {frac} accept the position. How many people accept the position?

gsms_0095.schema: {n1} students play {sport1} and {mult} that number play {sport2}, while {n2} boys and {n3} girls play {sport3}. If each student only participates in one group, how many students are there in total?

gsms_0096.schema: {cur}{budget} has been budgeted for {name}'s birthday party, her {parent} said. She wants to make sure that she and her friends all get one round of {activity1}, {cur}{tokens} in {activity2} tokens, and {times} on the {activity3}. A round of {activity1} costs {cur}{cost1}, and the {activity3} cost {cur}{cost2} a ride. How many friends can she invite?

gsms_0097.schema: Operating the cash register, {name1} is exactly {mult} as fast as her less-experienced colleague {name2}, who processes {n} customers daily. If they work all days of the week, what is the total weekly production for the two?

gsms_0098.schema: {n0} people are infected by a new {disease}. Each infected person infects {r} others every day. After {d} days, how many people are infected?

gsms_0099.schema: For {d1} days {name} eats {n1} eggs a day, and for the {d2} days after that he steps it up to {n2} eggs a day. Over the whole {d3} days, how many dozens of eggs will {name} need?
